Defines the bounded physical CUDA and Frozen-Environment FE-3 acceptance procedure, artifact format and interpretation limits; execution under this contract remains engineering verification and creates no DATA or EVID.

Defines the backend-neutral PAN hyperstate reference semantics prepared in Wave 5A. The contract is explicitly draft, does not establish CPU/CUDA equivalence, and creates no DATA, EVID or accepted scientific claim.
Defines the fail-closed Wave-5B PAN CPU/CUDA parity preparation, gate ordering and interpretation boundary without authorizing execution or promoting PAN to canonical integrated status.
Defines D1/D2/D3 parity, stable execution fingerprints and fail-closed comparison semantics; parity verification is not scientific evidence by itself.
